content.short: TON Access is a decentralized RPC network for TON dapps that make HTTP queries to blockchain state.
content.description: TON Access, powered by Orbs, provides anonymous and decentralized RPC access for TON applications. It helps web dapps query TON blockchain state over HTTP without relying on a single centralized endpoint. TON Access - a reliable, anonymous, decentralized RPC network for TON dapps making HTTP queries to blockchain state from web. Thank you for subscribing Sometimes we have interesting announcements to tell you. Important product areas are http api for, the open network (ton)., and decentralized.
